summary: This clinical trial is testing the addition of the drug evolocumab to standard treatments for patients with acute inflammation of the pancreas caused by very high fat levels in the blood. The study aims to see how well these treatments lower fat levels in the body. General Hospital of Shenyang Military Region is sponsoring the research, which plans to enroll 60 participants. The trial is currently Recruiting and has a status of No phase.

facts.sponsor: General Hospital of Shenyang Military Region
